user.title: Vacuum planner
user.description: Choose the robot and where presence comes from.

data_description.vacuum: Must support room cleaning via send_command room_clean (e.g. eufy robovac_mqtt).
data_description.task_status_sensor: A job counts as done when this sensor changes to "Completed".
data_description.error_sensor: Any text other than empty/none counts as an error.
data_description.water_sensor: Wet stages wait while the level is below the minimum.
data_description.dock_status_sensor: The next stage waits while the dock is washing or emptying.
data_description.proximity_entry: Provides the people, their distance and direction of travel.
data_description.guest_mode: No automatic cleaning while this is on.
data_description.workday_sensor: Off on a weekday means public holiday (quiet day).
data_description.calendars: Appointments that are running now tell when the flat stays empty.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Rooms that get a cleaning plan. You can type a room id if it is not listed.

data_description.blockers: e.g. a media player – the room waits until 5 minutes after it stops playing / turns off.
data_description.position: Rooms of a stage are cleaned in this order (neighbouring rooms next to each other).

notify.title: Notifications & fine tuning
notify.description: Phone of each person (Companion app) for pre-warnings, return questions and errors. Leave empty for no notifications.

data_description.stage_pause: Time in the dock after a stage (mop washing, emptying).
data_description.away_delay: Nobody home (and far enough away) for this long before cleaning starts.
data_description.return_buffer: The plan ends this long before the expected return.
data_description.travel_time: Added to the end of a calendar appointment.
data_description.default_absence: Used until enough absences have been learned.
data_description.stage_overhead: Leaving and returning to the dock, mop washing.
data_description.min_water: Wet stages wait below this level.

abort.already_configured: This robot already has a planner.

pick_entry.message: Several planners are set up – pass config_entry_id.

robot_busy.message: The robot is not in the dock or already running a job.

enqueue.name: Add to queue
enqueue.description: Adds rooms to the queue (manual entries come first).

front.name: To the front
front.description: Put the rooms at the front of the queue.

skip_today.name: Skip today
skip_today.description: A due room is not put back into the queue until tomorrow.

move.name: Move in queue
move.description: Moves a room to a position (0 = front).

clear_queue.name: Clear queue
clear_queue.description: Empties the queue; due rooms come back tomorrow.

enqueue_due.name: Queue due rooms
enqueue_due.description: Puts all due rooms into the queue, also those skipped today.

force.name: Ignore presence and time
force.description: Off: start as soon as the automatic conditions are met (without pre-warning).

return_home.name: Back to dock
return_home.description: Send a running robot back to the dock.

clean_now.name: Clean now
clean_now.description: Cleans rooms right away (counted in the plan when finished).

pause_room.name: Pause room
pause_room.description: Leaves rooms out of the plan for a while.

days.name: Days
days.description: Pause until the start of this many days from now (1 = until tomorrow).

set_plan.name: Set plan
set_plan.description: Changes mode and/or interval of a room.

set_last_cleaned.name: Set last cleaned
set_last_cleaned.description: Records when rooms were cleaned last.

skip_today.name: Not today
skip_today.description: No automatic cleaning today (the queue stays).

skip.name: Skip
skip.description: Off: allow automatic cleaning again today.
